title: A fix-check record the merge tool prints carries the chain's round lines
why: Lane commit-refuses-conflict-markers ([ended:lane:-commit-refuses-conflict-markers]), 23:24 CST Nov 8: `merge <pr> --review-record --fix-check OLD:...` prints a record with no Round lines, and `merge --reviewed` then rejects it ("open: the fix check passed, but no round is recorded"). The tool also refuses `--round` with `--fix-check`. Hit #2083 and #1937 tonight; each now needs a fresh round 3. Harm: one wasted reviewer round per PR, and a held batch.
note: Fix: the printer carries the chain's round lines into the record, or refuses to print one that --reviewed will reject. Related: steps fix-check-chain, record-tool-posts-itself. Order (coordinator 23:26 CST Nov 8): starts after step record-tool-posts-itself merges; all three edit the merge tool's record code.
